parrafo_2.es: Sus clientas repiten lo mismo en Booksy: una aplicación gentil, una energía que sube el ánimo y pestañas que se quedan puestas. 5.0 de calificación en 109 reseñas.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep saying the same thing on Booksy: a gentle hand, an energy that lifts your mood, and lashes that actually stay on. A 5.0 rating across 109 reviews.

items.quote: TamiJo is amazing and so talented. I had tried getting my lashes done before and gave up and thought I wasn’t destined to have my lashes done. Then I’m at Tami and gave her a chance and I will never look back. She’s amazing and gentle and the lashes stay on.
Every session with Tami is an instant boost of confidence. Her energy instantly uplifts you the moment you lay down on her lash bed. I walk out ready to take on the world!
THE ABSOLUTE BEST LASH ARTIST EVER!
